description: Read-only MCP access to the Skill Finder catalogue of open agent skills (SKILL.md instruction files). Search the catalogue by keyword, fetch one skill's details and install command, or list curated skills per AI agent. No authentication required; no write operations.
name: skill-finder-plus
title: Skill Finder MCP

tools.description: Keyword search over the skill catalogue, ranked by install count. Parameters: query, agent, limit.
tools.name: search_skills

tools.description: Full details for one skill, including its SKILL.md source URL and install command. Parameters: id.
tools.name: get_skill

tools.description: List the AI agents that have curated skill collections, with skill counts.
tools.name: list_agents
